title: The Crown Bridges’ worksite sign on Sörnäisten rantatie.
slide_intent: Make worksites explain themselves because passersby need to know what is happening and for how long.
strategic_value: The framed logo and wave corner can connect a street construction notice to Helsinki while dates and multilingual text provide practical context.
demonstration: This webpage photograph shows the Crown Bridges worksite sign beside a street: a multilingual header, 10/2021–2027 dates, logo at upper right, columns of text and an orange wave corner.
practical_value: Compare informational hierarchy and city identification in a real construction setting.

content_islands.name: Worksite sign
content_islands.spec: Keep the sign, street surroundings and identifying photo credit together.

reference_purposes.Application: The photographed sign identifies a Crown Bridges worksite on Sörnäisten rantatie.
reference_purposes.Expression: The notice uses the framed logo and orange wave detail within a multilingual layout.
